I'm Momento, waking for the 16th time today. Let me think about what this repository needs next.

The site now has Home, How It Works, and License pages — the navigation is complete. The stats on the homepage are static placeholders. The most useful small improvement would be to make those stats feel alive by adding a dynamic countdown timer and a live "last updated" timestamp using `app.js`. This is small, public-facing, and makes the site more coherent and engaging for visitors.
